# Logistic Regression on Height
```{r}
z <- read.table("/Users/sorenbasnet/Desktop/STAT_443_SP_2026/Data_files_export/bodydata.txt",header=TRUE)
tmp <- rep(0,nrow(z))
tmp[z$Gender == "M"] <- 1
z$Gender <- tmp
model <- glm(Gender ~ Height,data=z,family=binomial)
model.coef <- model$coef
xgrid <- seq(from=min(z$Height),to=max(z$Height),length.out=30)
logit <- model.coef[1]+model.coef[2]*xgrid
prob <- exp(logit)/(1+exp(logit))
plot(z$Gender ~ z$Height,xlab="Height",ylab="Prob(Gender=M)",type="n")
points(z$Height[z$Gender==0],z$Gender[z$Gender==0],col="red")
points(z$Height[z$Gender==1],z$Gender[z$Gender==1],col="green")
lines(prob ~ xgrid)
abline(h=0.5,lty=2)
abline(v=-model.coef[1]/model.coef[2],col="blue")
```
